description: Abgeleitete Toleranzwerte für ausgewählte Arzneimittelwirkstoffe in Trinkwasser is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by umweltbundesamt.at. Certain foreign substances such as pharmaceutical active substances and their metabolites are not covered by the Drinking Water Ordinance and are therefore referred to as so-called non-regulated foreign substances. For a few of these substances, tolerances are already available, which are considered to be the highest tolerable concentration in drinking water. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Derived tolerance values for selected drug active substances in drinking water" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Wasser, OpenDocument, Umweltkontrolle. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
